description: The lowest current price for a product on eBay (and Best Buy in the US), checked live in the shopper's own country and currency, plus Amazon and local shop links to compare. Works for the US, UK, Ireland, Canada, Australia, Germany, France, Italy and Spain; other countries get US results. The say field is a ready-made answer. Some links are affiliate links (see disclosure). Every tool is read-only: no sign-in and nothing about the user is stored. There are no ads or paid placements. Built by Good Turn Studio.
